subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt timestamped config-backup suffixes now, and if so must existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery files be preserved or converted during migration?
rationale: The change alters a user-visible config recovery contract and can remove existing rollback copies, so the permanent migration behavior is a maintainer product and compatibility decision rather than an automation-only cleanup.

options.title: Require Migration-Safe Timestamped Backups
options.body: Rework this PR or a replacement to preserve or convert existing numbered backups, add collision handling, and prove an upgrade run before merge.

options.title: Accept First-Run Legacy Pruning
options.body: Allow the timestamp-only cleanup to delete existing numbered backups on first write, explicitly owning the recovery-retention loss.

options.title: Keep The Numbered Ring
options.body: Decline the naming change for now and keep the current documented `.bak.1` through `.bak.4` recovery model.

recommendation.title: Require Migration-Safe Timestamped Backups
recommendation.body: Rework this PR or a replacement to preserve or convert existing numbered backups, add collision handling, and prove an upgrade run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible history in the config backup and config I/O area and is the best routing candidate for the migration/product decision.
